G1080.lang: I beget (of the male), (of the female) I bring forth, give birth to.

G1097.lang: I am taking in knowledge, come to know, learn; aor: I ascertained, realized.

G1120.lang: I fall on my knees before (in supplication), supplicate, entreat.

G1122.kort: a scribe, town-clerk, man of learning
G1122.lang: (a) in Jerusalem, a scribe, one learned in the Jewish Law, a religious teacher, (b) at Ephesus, the town-clerk, the secretary of the city, (c) a man of learning generally.

G1124.kort: a writing, passage of scripture, the scriptures
G1124.lang: (a) a writing, (b) a passage of scripture; plur: the scriptures.

G1150.lang: I tame, subdue, involving obedience and restraint.

G1159.lang: I spend, bear expense, waste, squander.

G1163.lang: it is necessary, inevitable; less frequently: it is a duty, what is proper.

G1165.kort: I hold up as an example
G1165.lang: I hold up as an example, make a show of, expose.

G1173.lang: a dinner, an afternoon or evening meal.

G1188.kort: on the right hand, right hand, right

G1211.lang: (a) in a clause expressing demand: so, then, (b) indeed, (c) truly.

G1223.lang: (a) gen: through, throughout, by the instrumentality of, (b) acc: through, on account of, by reason of, for the sake of, because of.

G1229.kort: I announce throughout, spread the news of
G1229.lang: I announce throughout (the world), spread the news of, give notice of, teach.

G1230.lang: I pass (of time); I continue through, intervene.

G1239.kort: I offer here and there, distribute, divide
G1239.lang: I offer here and there, distribute, divide, hand over.

G1244.lang: I divide into parts, cut asunder, distribute.

G1249.lang: a waiter, servant; then of any one who performs any service, an administrator.

G1256.lang: I converse, address, preach, lecture; I argue, reason.

G1259.kort: I become reconciled to, reconcile myself with
G1259.lang: I change, exchange; I reconcile, change enmity for friendship.

G1261.lang: a calculation, reasoning, thought, movement of thought, deliberation, plotting.

G1266.kort: I divide up into parts, break up, distribute
G1266.lang: I divide up into parts, break up; I distribute.

G1299.lang: I give orders to, prescribe, arrange.

G1304.lang: I tarry, continue, stay in a place.

G1308.kort: I carry through, differ, surpass, excel
G1308.lang: (a) trans: I carry through, hither and thither, (b) intrans: I am different, differ, and sometimes: I surpass, excel.
